note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application commands (File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help) and their sub-items
LibreOffice toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard spreadsheet actions (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Save, Print, formatting controls, etc.)
LibreOffice status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application state (Ready, cell reference, sheet name, zoom level, etc.)
Sheet tab list -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for default sheet names (Sheet1, Sheet2, etc.)
